title: Limitations
items:
[b][size=4]Limitations[/size][/b]
[list]
[*] Designed for vanilla and vanilla-like lootable containers.
[*] Custom storage-building mods may use building storage objects or render paths that do not expose the same compatible container target, so those buildings are not guaranteed to highlight or tint correctly.
[*] World tinting depends on Kenshi exposing a compatible render path for that specific container; screen-space markers are the more reliable highlight path.
[/list]
